provenance.source: NTA master question paper for Political Science (paper question numbers 236-285), AglaSem Docs copy at https://docs.aglasem.com/view/7f606cd4-c701-11f1-a888-0aa932765c8b (PDF https://cdn.aglasem.com/aglasem-doc/7f606cd4-c701-11f1-a888-0aa932765c8b/7f606cd4-c701-11f1-a888-0aa932765c8b.pdf), downloaded 22 Nov 2026 (9,554,997 bytes, 39 pages: cover + 38 print pages, English then Hindi for every question). English text transcribed from the page images (tmp/1122-coverage/pol-work/pages/pNN.png at 110 dpi); the OCR was used only to read question and option ids. Answers from NTA's CUET (UG) 2026 final answer key (option ids).
provenance.keySource: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 24-05-2026 (First) final key for subject 323 (Political Science) and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids (printed in consecutive order, so the key option id fixes the answer position).

bankRead: One read-only read on 22 Nov 2026 with the repo read script (SELECT only): 253 visible political_science rows, of which 224 pass readablePracticeQuestions (equals the 224 in the 21 Nov inventory snapshot). Served copy: tmp/1122-coverage/snap/political-science/served_rows.json and served_political_science.json.
keyCardDeck: data/keycards/decks/political_science.json (v6, 1098 cards; key_card_suspended was not re-read, the earlier subjects had none suspended)
syllabusSource: Bank chapter names for political_science (19 chapters); every question sits on the 2026 syllabus
method: data/coverage/METHOD.md (STRICT rule; doubtful = not covered; Key cards count for theory; an answer readable off a printed passage is skill). Facts written first: tmp/1122-coverage/checkerA-pol/A_facts_before_search.txt. Search: tmp/1122-coverage/checkerA-pol/s.mjs over the served copy and the deck.
paperStructure: One compulsory Political Science paper of 50 questions: Sub-section 1 = 40 single questions (Q236-275), Sub-section 2 = a comprehension passage on India and the Kyoto Protocol with 5 questions (Q276-280), Sub-section 3 = a comprehension passage on coalition politics in the 1990s with 5 questions (Q281-285). The printed section header says 42 questions, which does not match the 50 ids printed; the key has 50 rows for this shift.
